candidates.source_name: bne IntelliNews - Central Europe / Czech Republic desk
candidates.why_relevant: Homepage fetch confirmed a Central Europe desk that explicitly lists Czech Republic alongside Hungary, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia and the Baltics, with News / Data / Features / Opinion verticals. bne is the main English-language business wire for CEE and routinely summarises Czech bank results, ownership changes and regulatory events for a foreign-investor audience, effectively acting as the English translation layer for Czech-only announcements.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted editorial content; headline/link-level use normally acceptable, full-text reuse is not
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the Czech Republic country page and article listings on a schedule; store headline + URL + date + summary only. Country page URL pattern observed on site is intellinews.com/{country}/ and article pattern intellinews.com/{slug}-{id}/?source={country}. No RSS link was visible on the fetched homepage - test /feed/ during the deterministic verification pass.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of publisher homepage (assigned cell seed), structure read from navigation
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 on https://www.intellinews.com/czech-republic/ and on https://www.intellinews.com/publications/czech-republic/ while the site root returned full content on the same run - inconsistent 403 is characteristic of bot filtering on deeper paths, not a dead page. Treat the country page as unverified, not dead.

candidates.why_relevant: Independent English-language CEE platform (operated by Reinvantage, publishing since 2012). Its on-site search for 'Czech bank' returned real Czech banking and fintech articles, confirming genuine Czech coverage even though no Czech tag page appears in the top navigation. Useful for fintech/challenger-bank expansion stories, bank taxation debates and monetary-policy context that Czech-language outlets cover only domestically.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the WordPress-style search endpoint https://emerging-europe.com/?s={term} with Czech banking terms and the /business/ section index (paginated). Verified working search returns article-level URLs directly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of assigned cell seed outlet, then on-site search snowball

candidates.why_relevant: Highest-volume English fintech/payments trade news source (site reports ~154k stories) with a dedicated payments channel plus regulation, crypto, identity, security and AI channels, and a separate 'company updates' feed that republishes vendor and bank press releases. This is the main English channel where Czech payment-scheme, acquiring, instant-payments and bank-technology announcements surface for an international audience.
candidates.access_status: freemium - free community registration, Finextra Pro is paid
candidates.legal_status: terms of use published; copyrighted editorial. RSS is publisher-offered, so feed consumption is sanctioned
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the publisher RSS feed at https://www.finextra.com/rss/rss.aspx and poll /latest-news?page=N plus /channel/payments; filter on Czech entity names. Article URL pattern confirmed as /newsarticle/{id}/{slug}.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of assigned cell seed outlet; URL patterns and RSS path read off the latest-news page
candidates.observed_blocker: Two guessed search-URL patterns returned 404; the real search is a form POST, so entity filtering should be done client-side over the RSS/listing pages rather than via a query-string search URL.

candidates.why_relevant: Primary international wire for Czech bank earnings, M&A, licence and supervisory events; typically the first English rendering of a Czech-language regulatory filing or CNB decision, and the version cited by other outlets. Core to the English half of the mandated bilingual sweep for the CZ A1 workstream.
candidates.access_status: metered paywall on the public site; full wire access is a licensed LSEG product
candidates.legal_status: strictly copyrighted wire content; scraping is contrary to terms - use licensed feed or headline/link-level referencing only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape. Preferred route is a licensed Reuters/LSEG feed, or headline+URL capture via a permitted news aggregator. If only public access is available, restrict to metadata (headline, date, URL) and manual reading.
candidates.observed_blocker: The fetch tool returned 'unable to fetch from www.reuters.com' - a client-side domain restriction, not evidence about the site. Reuters is certainly live; no section URL could be confirmed this run, so no example URLs are asserted.

candidates.why_relevant: Second core international wire for Czech bank and payments deal flow, valuation context and cross-border M&A framing aimed at institutional investors. Frequently carries exclusives on Czech financial-sector ownership changes ahead of local outlets.
candidates.access_status: hard paywall plus aggressive bot protection; terminal content is licensed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape. Use a licensed subscription/terminal, or capture headline+URL only through a permitted aggregator.
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 with Retry-After: 0 on https://www.bloomberg.com/europe - classic bot-defence response. Site is live; treat as access-restricted, not dead.

candidates.why_relevant: FT-group specialist banking title; publishes the Top 1000 World Banks ranking and country/regional bank profiles, which are among the few English-language comparative datasets placing Czech banks against CEE peers. Valuable for benchmarking and for annual-report-derived balance-sheet comparisons.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/subscribed access for rankings and country features; capture metadata only. Verify the correct current domain and Czech/CEE section paths in the deterministic pass.
candidates.observed_blocker: Fetch tool returned 'unable to fetch from www.thebanker.com'. No structural detail could be confirmed; site status unverified, section URLs deliberately not asserted.

candidates.why_relevant: Long-running English-language Czech news site written for residents and foreign professionals. Its Business & Money desk translates and contextualises Czech retail-banking developments - fee changes, branch closures, new account and payment products, mortgage-market moves - that international wires ignore. This is a practical translation channel for consumer-facing Czech banking news.
candidates.access_status: mostly open; some articles gated as 'FOR MEMBERS' behind an Expats.cz membership
candidates.legal_status: Terms of Service published at https://www.expats.cz/czech-news/article/expats-terms; copyrighted editorial, sponsored/partner content is labelled
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the section index https://www.expats.cz/czech-news/economy plus /czech-news/daily-news. No RSS URL was exposed in the navigation; the publisher offers newsletters at /newsletters as an alternative delivery channel. Flag member-gated items rather than attempting to bypass them, and strip labelled partner content.
candidates.discovered_via_method: assigned cell seed; exact section href extracted from the site's own navigation markup
candidates.observed_blocker: Two guessed section paths 404'd; the canonical Business & Money href is /czech-news/economy per the site's own nav.

candidates.source_name: Radio Prague International (Cesky rozhlas / Radio Prague) - English service
candidates.why_relevant: State broadcaster Czech Radio's foreign service; publishes English versions of Czech domestic economic and business news, including CNB decisions, bank sector developments and consumer-payment topics. As a public broadcaster it is a stable, non-commercial English rendering of Czech-language coverage - exactly the translation channel this cell is meant to secure.
candidates.legal_status: public broadcaster content; reuse terms need checking on the site's own conditions page
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Retry with a browser-like user agent; the site is part of the radio.cz / Cesky rozhlas platform which historically exposes section feeds. Target the economy/business section and test for RSS during the deterministic verification pass.
candidates.discovered_via_method: assigned cell seed; fetch attempted twice
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 on both the root and /economy. Two 403s on different paths of the same host point to a user-agent/bot filter rather than removal; recorded as unverified, not dead.

candidates.why_relevant: Self-described largest English-language media outlet in the Czech Republic. Its Politics & Economics desk carries Czech corporate and economic news in English (observed topics include EU budget, wage and household-cost stories, and Czech companies in global rankings), making it a secondary translation channel for Czech banking and payments announcements aimed at the expatriate and foreign-business audience.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the WordPress category index /category/news/politics-economics/ and /category/news/czechia/. WordPress default feeds (category path + /feed/) are worth testing in the verification pass. Cross-check claims against a stronger source before use - editorial depth is thin and content is often aggregated.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from the English-language Czech media landscape; category URLs read off the site's own navigation
candidates.observed_blocker: A guessed /category/business/ path 404'd; the real economics category is /category/news/politics-economics/.

candidates.source_name: CTK - Czech News Agency, foreign/English service
candidates.why_relevant: The national news agency and the upstream origin of most Czech financial news that international outlets republish. Its English-language service for foreign clients covers political, business and economic reporting, and it also runs a press-release distribution service (CTK Connect / Protext) plus an Infobank archive - so it is simultaneously the wire, the press-release pipe and the archive. Identifying it maps the supply chain behind everything else in this cell.
candidates.legal_status: licensed wire content - redistribution requires a contract; press-release distribution arm has separate terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial route: negotiate an English news-report or Infobank (ib.ctk.cz) licence for banking/finance keywords. Free route: monitor the corporate press-release distribution output, which is often republished openly. Do not scrape the paid wire.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball - traced upstream from English outlets that republish Czech financial news
candidates.observed_blocker: A guessed services path 404'd; the root resolved and listed the service lines (News Reports, Photobank, Press Releases, Infobank, Videobank, Infographics, CTK Connect).

candidates.why_relevant: Amsterdam-based global payments and fintech news platform with explicit coverage of payments, ecommerce, fraud, crypto/CBDC, regulation and M&A. Complements Finextra for European payments-market events touching Czech acquirers, PSPs, licence grants and cross-border payment deals; also publishes reference reports that map market participants.
candidates.access_status: freemium - news open, reports require registration
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; registration terms apply to gated reports
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll news listings and the M&A/regulation sections, filtering for Czech entities; RSS is referenced by the publisher - confirm the exact feed URL in the verification pass. Registration-gated reports should be acquired manually, not scripted.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who sells payments-market intelligence in English) then direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Specialist English retail-banking trade title covering strategy, regulation, products, distribution and channel technology, backed by GlobalData's deals/M&A and company-intelligence databases. Relevant to A1 because it aggregates bank announcements and deal records into a structured English layer that can be filtered for Czech institutions.
candidates.access_status: hybrid - news open, 'Premium' items and data reports gated
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; GlobalData data products are separately licensed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the news index and filter on Czech entity names; no RSS URL was exposed on the page fetched, so test common Verdict-network feed paths in the verification pass. Do not attempt to pull the gated GlobalData deals database.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (specialist English retail-banking press) then direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Specialist English coverage of central banks and financial regulators, with explicit sections for monetary policy, financial stability and micro-prudential supervision, payments systems, CBDC, and fintech/regtech/suptech. This is the natural English channel for Czech National Bank policy, supervision and payment-system developments that would otherwise only appear in Czech, and it also runs benchmarking data and awards.
candidates.access_status: tiered - registration required, premium journal/benchmarking behind subscription
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Registered access; monitor the payments and financial-stability sections for CNB items. Capture metadata plus short summaries only; do not mirror premium content.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who covers regulators in English) then direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Publishes country-level financial data and rankings for 180+ nations plus annual Best Bank / Best Digital Bank / Best Treasury and Cash Management awards broken out by country, which produce recurring English-language snapshots naming leading Czech banks. Useful as a low-effort annual benchmark and as a pointer to which Czech institutions are visible internationally.
candidates.access_status: freemium - free content plus paid print/digital subscription
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/quarterly pull of the country-award and country-data pages filtered to the Czech Republic; newsletter subscription for ongoing items. Low polling frequency is sufficient.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (English rankings/awards that name banks by country) then direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: High-volume English payments publication with an EMEA desk and cross-border payments coverage. Included for completeness of the English payments layer, but an on-site search for 'Czech' returned mostly EU-wide and Poland-centric items with no Czech-focused article on the first page - so Czech relevance is incidental rather than systematic.
candidates.access_status: registration wall - 'complete the form to unlock this article'
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; registration required for full articles
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency keyword sweep of https://www.pymnts.com/?s=Czech and the EMEA section; treat as an opportunistic rather than a scheduled source given the weak Czech signal and the registration wall.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference then direct fetch of the site's own search endpoint
candidates.observed_blocker: Registration wall reported on article pages; search results page itself was readable.

candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates company news, regulatory filings and analyst commentary per listed issuer in English, including Prague Stock Exchange-listed banks. Valuable as a pointer layer: a per-company news timeline that reveals which English outlets and which primary disclosures exist for a given Czech bank, without having to guess each issuer's IR page.
candidates.legal_status: aggregated third-party content under licence; scraping contrary to terms - use for discovery and manual reading
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use manually as a discovery/pointer tool to enumerate per-issuer news sources, then collect from the primary issuer IR site instead. Do not build a scraper against it.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who aggregates issuer news in English) then fetch attempt
queries_used: attempted fetch of a constructed issuer news URL on marketscreener.com (403)
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 on the attempted issuer news page. Because the exact issuer URL was constructed rather than observed, no example URL is asserted here - the issuer page path must be discovered through the site's own search during verification.

candidates.why_relevant: English-language legal-market publication for Central and Eastern Europe with country desks. Law-firm deal announcements are an early and unusually precise English record of Czech banking and payments M&A, licence transfers and financing transactions - often naming parties and structures before or instead of mainstream coverage.
candidates.access_status: open with some registration (unverified this run)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Retry with a browser-like user agent; locate the Czech Republic country index through the site's own navigation rather than a guessed path, then poll deal announcements.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who publishes deal news in English for CEE) then fetch attempt
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 on the guessed Czech country path. Both the path correctness and the site's live status are unverified; recorded as a hypothesis, not a dead source.

candidates.why_relevant: English banking-technology and fintech trade title (long-running, formerly Banking Technology). Typical channel for core-banking, card-processing and payments-vendor contract wins involving Czech banks - the kind of supplier-side announcement that rarely appears in mainstream Czech media but matters for a payments-technology market view.
candidates.access_status: open with newsletter/registration prompts (unverified this run)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Retry with a browser-like user agent; test for an RSS feed and poll news listings filtered on Czech bank and vendor names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who reports bank-technology supplier deals in English) then fetch attempt
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 on the site root. Site is well established and almost certainly live; recorded as unverified.

candidates.source_name: Newton Media (Czech media monitoring, English-facing arm)
candidates.why_relevant: Commercial Czech media-monitoring house. If accessible, a monitoring vendor is the highest-leverage pointer source in this cell: it enumerates which outlets - Czech and international - actually publish on a given bank, and can surface foreign coverage of Czech banks that no single outlet index would reveal. Included as a pointer hypothesis, not a content source.
candidates.legal_status: licensed press-clipping service; redistribution of monitored content is contractually restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Verify the correct current domain and English landing page during the deterministic pass; if the vendor is live, evaluate a keyword-monitoring subscription for Czech bank and payments entities rather than attempting any automated collection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who aggregates and archives media coverage commercially) then fetch attempt
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 404 on the guessed /en path. Domain correctness is unverified - this entry is a lead to confirm, and must not be treated as a confirmed source.

negative_findings.description: The mandatory Czech-language (cs) search leg of this cell was not executed. The session's shared WebSearch budget (200/200 calls) was already exhausted by other agents before this agent issued its first query, so zero searches - English or Czech - could be run. All findings below and all candidates above were produced by direct URL fetching and on-site navigation/snowballing instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 WebSearch queries executed; 0 Czech-language queries; ~25 direct fetches performed instead. The Czech seed query 'zahranicni media o ceskych bankach anglicky zprava akvizice' was never run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The bilingual requirement is unmet for this cell. Czech-language pointer sources - Czech articles citing or summarising foreign coverage, Czech press-release wires, Czech media-monitoring listings - would have snowballed into international outlets that direct-fetching cannot surface. Discovery here is biased toward outlets already named in the cell brief plus what could be inferred from first principles.

negative_findings.description: Kafkadesk (kafkadesk.org), previously an English-language Visegrad/Central Europe news site that would have fit this cell, no longer serves Central European news. The fetched root returned content about Norwegian online casinos.
negative_findings.result_summary: kafkadesk.org root fetch succeeded but returned unrelated gambling-affiliate content; /category/czech-republic/ returned 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a stale entry being added to the source registry, and flags that any historical Kafkadesk URLs already held elsewhere in the registry are now unsafe to re-fetch or cite.

negative_findings.description: The two most authoritative sources in this cell - Reuters and Bloomberg - could not be inspected. Reuters and thebanker.com were refused at the fetch-tool layer ('unable to fetch from this domain'); Bloomberg returned HTTP 403 with Retry-After: 0.
negative_findings.result_summary: reuters.com: tool-level domain block. thebanker.com: tool-level domain block. bloomberg.com: HTTP 403 bot defence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: No section URLs, feed paths or paywall specifics could be confirmed for the highest-credibility English sources on Czech banking. These are access hypotheses to resolve, not evidence that anything is unavailable - all three are certainly live. Practically, all three will need licensed access rather than collection.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was exposed in the fetched markup for Expats.cz, Prague Morning, Emerging Europe, Retail Banker International or bne IntelliNews. Only Finextra published an explicit feed path (/rss/rss.aspx); The Paypers and Global Finance reference feeds/newsletters without a confirmed URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: 1 of ~8 candidate outlets exposed a confirmed feed URL; the rest will require HTML listing polling or feed-path probing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cost for this cell is higher than a news-cell normally implies: most sources need scheduled HTML listing polls with entity filtering rather than cheap feed subscriptions, and several are WordPress sites where standard feed paths should be probed before writing scrapers.

negative_findings.description: PYMNTS, one of the largest English payments publications, showed no Czech-focused articles on the first page of its own 'Czech' search; results skewed EU-wide and Poland-centric.
negative_findings.result_summary: On-site search returned 48 pages of nominal matches but no Czech-specific headline in the visible results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: the global payments trade press treats the Czech market as incidental. Czech payments signal is more likely to come from Finextra company updates, The Paypers M&A items and Czech-language sources than from the large US-centric payments outlets.

negative_findings.description: Several plausible section paths guessed from site conventions returned 404 and were corrected against each site's own navigation: expats.cz Business & Money is /czech-news/economy (not /section/business-money or /business); Prague Morning economics is /category/news/politics-economics/ (not /category/business/); Finextra has no query-string search endpoint at /search or /newssearch; ctk.eu has no /services/foreign_service/ page.
negative_findings.result_summary: 4 guessed paths 404'd and were replaced with navigation-derived URLs; 1 (Finextra search) has no query-string equivalent at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents that the URLs recorded for these candidates were read from site navigation rather than assumed, and warns the collection layer not to construct section URLs by convention for these domains.

coverage_gaps.description: Zero Czech-language discovery was performed for this cell because the session-wide web-search budget was exhausted before the agent's first query. The cell's own Czech seed query was never run, and no Czech glossary/actor-map terms were exercised against a search engine.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with search budget available, executing the Czech seed query and Czech-language probes for foreign coverage of Czech banks (e.g. terms around foreign media, acquisition and results announcements in Czech). At minimum, run a Czech-language sweep for pointer pages that list which international outlets cover Czech finance.

coverage_gaps.description: Six candidates (Reuters, Bloomberg, The Banker, Radio Prague International, CEE Legal Matters, FinTech Futures, plus MarketScreener and the intellinews Czech country page) could not be inspected due to 403s or tool-level domain blocks. Their section URLs, feed availability and paywall mechanics are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic verification pass retry these hosts with browser-like headers and, where still blocked, record them as access-restricted-but-live. Do not mark any of them dead on the single failed fetch recorded here.

coverage_gaps.description: Paid English deal-intelligence and filings-aggregation services that would systematically capture Czech banking M&A and licence events - Mergermarket/ION Analytics, LSEG/Refinitiv Deals, S&P Capital IQ, Dealogic, PitchBook - were not assessed at all this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass on commercial deal databases, assessing licence cost, Czech financial-sector coverage depth and whether an existing organisational subscription already provides access.

coverage_gaps.description: No per-issuer mapping was built. Which specific Czech banking and payments entities each international outlet actually names - and therefore which entities are reliably visible in English at all - remains unknown, since entity-level searching was impossible.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once search is available, run entity-name probes for the major Czech banking groups and payment institutions against each confirmed outlet's on-site search (Emerging Europe and PYMNTS both expose working ?s= endpoints) and record hit counts per outlet as a coverage matrix.

coverage_gaps.description: Feed availability is confirmed for only one outlet in this cell, and no robots.txt or rate-limit posture was checked for any domain.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During verification, probe standard feed paths (/feed/, /rss, /rss.xml, category+/feed/) for the WordPress-style sites and fetch robots.txt for every candidate domain before any scheduled polling is configured.

brief: The English-language layer over Czech banking and payments splits into four tiers: authoritative international wires (Reuters, Bloomberg, plus CTK's licensed English service upstream of both) that carry Czech bank results, M&A and licence events but are paywalled, bot-defended and unscrapable; a CEE regional tier (bne IntelliNews, which explicitly desks the Czech Republic, and Emerging Europe, whose on-site search returned genuine Czech banking and fintech articles) that is the most collectible high-signal layer; a payments and banking-technology trade tier (Finextra - the only outlet here publishing a confirmed RSS feed - plus The Paypers, Retail Banker International, Central Banking for CNB matters, and FinTech Futures) where Czech items appear as vendor deals and regulatory notes; and a local English-for-expats tier (Expats.cz Business & Money at /czech-news/economy, Prague Morning, Radio Prague International) that functions as the de facto translation channel for consumer-facing Czech banking news. Two structural cautions: the large global payments outlets treat Czechia as incidental (a PYMNTS search for 'Czech' surfaced no Czech-focused headline on page one), and one former fit for this cell, Kafkadesk, has been repurposed into unrelated affiliate content. The material limitation of this run is that the session's web-search budget was fully consumed before this agent's first query, so all discovery was done by direct fetching and on-site snowballing and the mandatory Czech-language leg was never executed - this cell should be re-run with search available before its coverage is considered complete.
